Sub FixSh(oSh)
On Error Resume Next
b = False
If InStr(oSh.String, ""<number>"") > 0 Then b = True
oEnum = oSh.Text.createEnumeration()
Do While oEnum.hasMoreElements()
oPar = oEnum.nextElement()
oPE = oPar.createEnumeration()
Do While oPE.hasMoreElements()
oP = oPE.nextElement()
If oP.TextPortionType = ""TextField"" Then b = True
Loop
Loop
If b Then oSh.CharColor = RGB(255,0,0)
End Sub
